changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.sql: UPDATE catalog_dataset SET source_id = ( SELECT id FROM infra_data_source WHERE upper(type) = 'INCEPTOR' ORDER BY created_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) WHERE source_id IS NULL AND upper(type) = 'INCEPTOR' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM infra_data_source WHERE upper(type) = 'INCEPTOR');

UPDATE catalog_dataset SET source_id = ( SELECT id FROM infra_data_source WHERE upper(type) = 'POSTGRES' AND upper(status) = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) WHERE source_id IS NULL AND upper(type) = 'POSTGRES' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM infra_data_source WHERE upper(type) = 'POSTGRES' AND upper(status) = 'ACTIVE');
